name: six-face-aimed-run
description: The DEFAULT six-face run in policy mode with the 8-way AIM reflexes (T-018). Same shape as six-face-full-run.json (hold fire, hold right while the world scrolls, hop on every landing, dodge a houndframe's plant) with one thing added: the relative-geometry clauses from lib/threat.mjs, so the bot holds `up` when a hostile sits on its 45-degree or straight-up firing ray and turns to face the side its nearest hostile is on during a wave gate. Nothing about the game changes; this is the same build, played with an aim the old grammar could not express. See docs/playtests/2026-08-gate-fight-harness.md for why the aimless version stalls at wave gate 2.
